gen-pirata-one-fs-fira-sans: Pirata One is gothic and commanding, its letters packed nose to tail. Fira Sans takes over with a generous x-height and uniform strokes, so paragraphs of it should move along without any fuss.
gen-pirata-one-fs-merriweather-sans: Words look sturdy and large here, every e opening its eye clearly to the right. Merriweather Sans handles the steady reading, while Pirata One saves its gothic punch for the big, commanding moments.
gen-pirata-one-fs-ranade: Gothic and crowded up top, Pirata One sets its letters nose to tail. Ranade loosens everything below with widely spaced letters and a faint pressure variation, and that open spacing is the real hook.
gen-pirata-one-fs-supreme: Crisp and heavy through the middle, Supreme keeps its letters held open beneath the gothic crowding of Pirata One. Both fonts carry real weight, just in very different dress.
gen-pirata-one-general-sans: Gothic bite on top, then smooth glass-tube curves underneath. Pirata One does the commanding, nose-to-tail shouting, while General Sans does the quiet work of smooth, steady reading in an x-height that fills the line.
gen-pirata-one-manrope: Manrope opens every curve with a bright gap and keeps its glyphs looking cut from equal-width strips. Pirata One adds a gothic growl up top; Manrope keeps things friendly.
gen-pirata-one-satoshi: Pirata One packs gothic, commanding letters tightly nose to tail. Satoshi gives it room to breathe, with a soaring x-height and a wide-open e, all drawn with ballpoint-pen steadiness.
gen-pirata-one-switzer: Letters crammed nose to tail give Pirata One its gothic bite. Switzer, with tubular wire-like forms and a tall waist line, should make extended text feel clean and approachable.
gen-pirata-one-work-sans: Pirata One arrives gothic and commanding, letters pressed nose to tail. Work Sans then moves in with contemporary ribbon-like strokes of constant width and a high mean line, softening the gothic mood.
gen-plus-jakarta-sans-fs-literata: Plus Jakarta Sans keeps its curves thread-like and its letter openings wide, with no swelling in the bowls. Literata adds a sophisticated, bookish note, its stems and joining strokes only slightly different in weight.
